title: Frame Courtesy for Long-Standing Members — Northgate Optical Questions and Answers
content:
**What is the frame courtesy?** An amount given back to a long-standing member out of the amounts kept from a Northgate Optical frame return refund. Where the membership on the job has been held for at least 60 whole months, a frame courtesy of 5.00 is given back out of the amounts kept, and where it has been held for at least 24 but fewer than 60 whole months, the frame courtesy is 2.50.

**Which membership is read?** The membership presented on the eyewear job, as recorded on Northgate Memberships. Its months held are the whole months from its opened date to the day the frame return refund is worked out.

**And a membership held fewer than 24 whole months?** No frame courtesy is given.

**Is the patient's own membership relevant?** No. Only the membership on the job is read.

| Whole months the membership on the job has been held | Frame courtesy |
|---|---|
| fewer than 24 | none |
| 24 to 59 | 2.50 |
| 60 or more | 5.00 |

**Edge questions (hypothetical memberships).**

- Held exactly 24 whole months: 2.50.
- Held 59 whole months: 2.50.
- Held exactly 60 whole months: 5.00.
